card.name: Strong before CYP enzyme inhibitors
card.fires_on: The word "strong" (or "Strong") right after "with" or "a" in drug-interaction text, just before CYP3A4/CYP2D6 inhibitor or inducer terms.

modes.label: Strong before CYP
modes.description: "strong" after coadministered with, introducing a CYP inhibitor or inducer.
modes.example: mg 75 mg Encorafenib exposure at the 75 mg QD BRAFTOVI dosage when coadministered with a<< strong>> CYP3A4 inhibitor is expected

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: A rare word start in a drug context, such as the R of a brand name or the m in 99mTc.

card.writes: It seems to push word beginnings and pieces of names, with no clear theme.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "strong" when a label says a drug is used with a strong enzyme inhibitor.
